units.source_text: 我们的寺庙蚊帐很少，估计父亲的结核病不大会传染了，

en.t: Our temple had very few mosquito nets, and it was thought that Father’s tuberculosis was no longer very likely to spread,

units.source_text: 母亲和我就同父亲共用一床帐子，如今再加上仓并。

en.t: so Mother and I shared one net with Father, and now Kuranami had been added as well.

units.source_text: 我记得，那是在夏天的一个深夜里，沿着庭院的树木，

en.t: I remember that it was late on a summer night, along the trees in the garden,

units.source_text: 我仿佛听见无数的蝉发出了知了知了的短促的悲鸣，飞来又飞去。

en.t: when I seemed to hear countless cicadas giving short, mournful cries of chirring as they flew back and forth.

units.source_text: 大概是这种声音把我惊醒了。

en.t: It was probably that sound that startled me awake.

units.source_text: 海潮怒吼，海风掀起了黄绿色的帐子的下角。

en.t: The tide roared, and the sea wind lifted the lower corner of the yellow-green mosquito net.
The way the net fluttered was strangely unusual.
